lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 妳不是星期一才去辦簽證嗎？怎麼今天就拿到了？
lines.simplified: 你不是星期一才去办签证吗？怎么今天就拿到了？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ bú shì xīngqíyī cái qù bàn qiānzhèng ma? Zěnme jīntiān jiù ná dào le?
lines.english: Didn't you only apply for your visa on Monday? How have you got it already today?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 我也嚇了一跳。我猜是因為最近去的人少，辦手續特別順利。
lines.simplified: 我也吓了一跳。我猜是因为最近去的人少，办手续特别顺利。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ yě xià le yí tiào. Wǒ cāi shì yīnwèi zuìjìn qù de rén shǎo, bàn shǒuxù tèbié shùnlì.
lines.english: It surprised me too. I guess the paperwork went smoothly because fewer people are going there lately.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 這麼說，妳下個月去非洲的旅行，都準備好了？
lines.simplified: 这么说，你下个月去非洲的旅行，都准备好了？
lines.pinyin: Zhème shuō, nǐ xià ge yuè qù Fēizhōu de lǚxíng, dōu zhǔnbèi hǎo le?
lines.english: So your trip to Africa next month is all ready, then?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 簽證是沒問題了，可是機票還沒買，我還不確定要哪一天出發。
lines.simplified: 签证是没问题了，可是机票还没买，我还不确定要哪一天出发。
lines.pinyin: Qiānzhèng shì méi wèntí le, kěshì jīpiào hái méi mǎi, wǒ hái bú quèdìng yào nǎ yì tiān chūfā.
lines.english: The visa is sorted, but I haven't bought the plane ticket; I'm still not sure which day to leave.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的一開口為什麼覺得意外？
prompt.simplified: 男的一开口为什么觉得意外？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de yì kāikǒu wèishénme juéde yìwài?
prompt.english: Why is the man surprised at the start?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 他以為她已經買好機票
choices.simplified: 他以为她已经买好机票
choices.pinyin: Tā yǐwéi tā yǐjīng mǎi hǎo jīpiào.
choices.english: He thought she had already bought her ticket.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 他以為她今天才去辦手續
choices.simplified: 他以为她今天才去办手续
choices.pinyin: Tā yǐwéi tā jīntiān cái qù bàn shǒuxù.
choices.english: He thought she would only do the paperwork today.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 他以為她還得多等幾天
choices.simplified: 他以为她还得多等几天
choices.pinyin: Tā yǐwéi tā hái děi duō děng jǐ tiān.
choices.english: He thought she would have to wait a few more days.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā yǐwéi tā huì tízǎo chūguó.
choices.english: He thought she would leave the country early.

questions.why: 星期一才……今天就…… shows the visa arrived sooner than the man expected. He asks about the ticket later and already knows she did the paperwork on Monday.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 這雙球鞋我才穿去爬了一趟山就破了，我想拿回去換。
lines.simplified: 这双球鞋我才穿去爬了一趟山就破了，我想拿回去换。
lines.pinyin: Zhè shuāng qiúxié wǒ cái chuān qù pá le yí tàng shān jiù pò le, wǒ xiǎng ná huíqù huàn.
lines.english: I've only worn these shoes on one mountain trip and they're already torn. I want to take them back and exchange them.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 一趟？那趟你不是在偏僻的山區走了五天嗎？
lines.simplified: 一趟？那趟你不是在偏僻的山区走了五天吗？
lines.pinyin: Yí tàng? Nà tàng nǐ bú shì zài piānpì de shānqū zǒu le wǔ tiān ma?
lines.english: One trip? Didn't you walk for five days in a remote mountain area on that trip?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 是啊，路又溼又滑，每天都走八、九個小時。
lines.simplified: 是啊，路又湿又滑，每天都走八、九个小时。
lines.pinyin: Shì a, lù yòu shī yòu huá, měi tiān dōu zǒu bā, jiǔ ge xiǎoshí.
lines.english: Yes, the paths were wet and slippery, and we walked eight or nine hours every day.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那不是鞋子的問題吧。那種路走久了，球鞋很容易破。
lines.simplified: 那不是鞋子的问题吧。那种路走久了，球鞋很容易破。
lines.pinyin: Nà bú shì xiézi de wèntí ba. Nà zhǒng lù zǒu jiǔ le, qiúxié hěn róngyì pò.
lines.english: Then it isn't the shoes' fault. Sneakers tear easily after a long walk on paths like that.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的是什麼意思？
prompt.simplified: 女的是什么意思？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de shì shénme yìsi?
prompt.english: What does the woman mean?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 鞋子壞了是因為路太難走
choices.simplified: 鞋子坏了是因为路太难走
choices.pinyin: Xiézi huài le shì yīnwèi lù tài nán zǒu.
choices.english: The shoes broke because the walking was so hard.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xiézi de pǐnzhí zhēn de tài chà.
choices.english: The shoes really are of poor quality.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 他應該去走比較短的路
choices.simplified: 他应该去走比较短的路
choices.pinyin: Tā yīnggāi qù zǒu bǐjiào duǎn de lù.
choices.english: He should walk shorter routes.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 他應該拿去店裡換一雙
choices.simplified: 他应该拿去店里换一双
choices.pinyin: Tā yīnggāi ná qù diàn lǐ huàn yì shuāng.
choices.english: He should exchange them at the shop.

questions.why: He says one trip sounds like little wear, but she reminds him it meant five long days on wet mountain paths. Taking the shoes back was his plan.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我跟女朋友分開了。我想下個星期一個人去東部走走。
lines.simplified: 我跟女朋友分开了。我想下个星期一个人去东部走走。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ gēn nǚpéngyǒu fēnkāi le. Wǒ xiǎng xià ge xīngqí yí ge rén qù dōngbù zǒuzǒu.
lines.english: My girlfriend and I have split up. I'm thinking of going to the east coast on my own next week.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 失戀的時候出去走走也好。不過話說回來，你下個星期不是有兩個報告要交嗎？
lines.simplified: 失恋的时候出去走走也好。不过话说回来，你下个星期不是有两个报告要交吗？
lines.pinyin: Shīliàn de shíhòu chūqù zǒuzǒu yě hǎo. Búguò huà shuō huílái, nǐ xià ge xīngqí bú shì yǒu liǎng ge bàogào yào jiāo ma?
lines.english: Getting away after a break-up is not a bad idea. But then again, don't you have two reports due next week?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我帶電腦去。白天去好幾個地方，晚上在旅館寫。
lines.simplified: 我带电脑去。白天去好几个地方，晚上在旅馆写。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ dài diànnǎo qù. Báitiān qù hǎo jǐ ge dìfāng, wǎnshàng zài lǚguǎn xiě.
lines.english: I'll take my computer. I'll visit lots of places by day and write at the hotel in the evenings.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 行程排得這麼滿，絕對寫不完。先交報告再出發吧。
lines.simplified: 行程排得这么满，绝对写不完。先交报告再出发吧。
lines.pinyin: Xíngchéng pái de zhème mǎn, juéduì xiě bù wán. Xiān jiāo bàogào zài chūfā ba.
lines.english: With a schedule that full, you'll never finish them. Hand in the reports first, then go.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的是什麼意思？
prompt.simplified: 女的是什么意思？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de shì shénme yìsi?
prompt.english: What does the woman mean?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 失戀了最好別一個人出去
choices.simplified: 失恋了最好别一个人出去
choices.pinyin: Shīliàn le zuìhǎo bié yí ge rén chūqù.
choices.english: After a break-up it's best not to go out alone.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Děng bàogào xiě wán zài chūfā.
choices.english: Leave once the reports are done.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 帶電腦去旅館寫報告就好
choices.simplified: 带电脑去旅馆写报告就好
choices.pinyin: Dài diànnǎo qù lǚguǎn xiě bàogào jiù hǎo.
choices.english: Taking the computer to write at the hotel is fine.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 應該跟女朋友再談一談
choices.simplified: 应该跟女朋友再谈一谈
choices.pinyin: Yīnggāi gēn nǚpéngyǒu zài tán yì tán.
choices.english: He should talk to his girlfriend again.

questions.why: 話說回來 moves from agreeing that a trip might help to the reports due next week. Writing at the hotel was his idea, while she wants the work handed in before he leaves.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 我比較想報名旅行團。行程都安排好了，從景點到旅館都有車。
lines.simplified: 我比较想报名旅行团。行程都安排好了，从景点到旅馆都有车。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ bǐjiào xiǎng bàomíng lǚxíngtuán. Xíngchéng dōu ānpái hǎo le, cóng jǐngdiǎn dào lǚguǎn dōu yǒu chē.
lines.english: I would rather sign up for a group tour. The itinerary is arranged and there is transport from the sights to the hotel.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 那是比較輕鬆。不過每個景點只停半小時，才剛開始欣賞風景，車又要開了。
lines.simplified: 那是比较轻松。不过每个景点只停半小时，才刚开始欣赏风景，车又要开了。
lines.pinyin: Nà shì bǐjiào qīngsōng. Búguò měi ge jǐngdiǎn zhǐ tíng bàn xiǎoshí, cái gāng kāishǐ xīnshǎng fēngjǐng, chē yòu yào kāi le.
lines.english: Sure, it's more relaxed. But there is only half an hour at each stop—you've only just started enjoying the scenery and the bus is about to leave.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 話說回來，你上次一個人去，不是也在車站等車等了三個小時？
lines.simplified: 话说回来，你上次一个人去，不是也在车站等车等了三个小时？
lines.pinyin: Huà shuō huílái, nǐ shàng cì yí ge rén qù, bú shì yě zài chēzhàn děng chē děng le sān ge xiǎoshí?
lines.english: But then again, when you went on your own last time, didn't you wait three hours for a bus at the station?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 那是因為我沒先確認時間，下次就不會了。
lines.simplified: 那是因为我没先确认时间，下次就不会了。
lines.pinyin: Nà shì yīnwèi wǒ méi xiān quèrèn shíjiān, xià cì jiù bú huì le.
lines.english: That was because I didn't check the times first. It won't happen next time.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的提到車站的事，是想說什麼？
prompt.simplified: 女的提到车站的事，是想说什么？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de tí dào chēzhàn de shì, shì xiǎng shuō shénme?
prompt.english: What is the woman getting at when she mentions the station?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 旅行團的車也可能晚到
choices.simplified: 旅行团的车也可能晚到
choices.pinyin: Lǚxíngtuán de chē yě kěnéng wǎn dào.
choices.english: Tour buses can be late too.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Lǚxíngtuán qù de jǐngdiǎn tài shǎo.
choices.english: A tour visits too few sights.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Měi ge jǐngdiǎn dōu tíng de tài duǎn.
choices.english: Every stop is too short.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 自己去也會花掉很多時間
choices.simplified: 自己去也会花掉很多时间
choices.pinyin: Zìjǐ qù yě huì huā diào hěn duō shíjiān.
choices.english: Going alone can waste a lot of time too.

questions.why: He objects to short stops on group tours, but she brings up the bus station to show that traveling alone can also cost time. Short stops are his objection.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我剛剛打電話給民宿，老闆說山區一連下了兩天雨，有一段路塌了。
lines.simplified: 我刚刚打电话给民宿，老板说山区一连下了两天雨，有一段路塌了。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ gānggāng dǎ diànhuà gěi mínsù, lǎobǎn shuō shānqū yìlián xià le liǎng tiān yǔ, yǒu yí duàn lù tā le.
lines.english: I just rang the guesthouse. The owner says it rained in the mountains for two days straight and a stretch of road collapsed.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 這麼說，我們星期六上山看日出，看不成了？
lines.simplified: 这么说，我们星期六上山看日出，看不成了？
lines.pinyin: Zhème shuō, wǒmen xīngqíliù shàng shān kàn rìchū, kàn bù chéng le?
lines.english: So we won't get to go up and watch the sunrise on Saturday?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 也不一定。老闆說，路星期五晚上以前就會修好，雨也會停。
lines.simplified: 也不一定。老板说，路星期五晚上以前就会修好，雨也会停。
lines.pinyin: Yě bù yídìng. Lǎobǎn shuō, lù xīngqíwǔ wǎnshàng yǐqián jiù huì xiū hǎo, yǔ yě huì tíng.
lines.english: Not necessarily. He says the road will be fixed by Friday evening, and the rain will stop too.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那我們星期五早上再打一次電話確認吧。
lines.simplified: 那我们星期五早上再打一次电话确认吧。
lines.pinyin: Nà wǒmen xīngqíwǔ zǎoshàng zài dǎ yí cì diànhuà quèrèn ba.
lines.english: Then let's ring again on Friday morning to make sure.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的一開始以為會怎麼樣？
prompt.simplified: 女的一开始以为会怎么样？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de yì kāishǐ yǐwéi huì zěnmeyàng?
prompt.english: What did the woman think at first?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xīngqíliù méi bànfǎ shàng shān le.
choices.english: They would not be able to go up on Saturday.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Lù yào dào xīngqíwǔ cái xiū hǎo.
choices.english: The road would not be fixed until Friday.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Mínsù lǎobǎn bú ràng tāmen zhù.
choices.english: The owner would not let them stay.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tāmen děi zǎo yì tiān shàng shān.
choices.english: They would have to go up a day early.

questions.why: 這麼說 draws a conclusion from the rain and damaged road: she fears the sunrise trip will fall through. The news about the repairs comes next and changes the situation.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你跟哥哥的旅行日記我看了。十二天，你們去了幾個國家？
lines.simplified: 你跟哥哥的旅行日记我看了。十二天，你们去了几个国家？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ gēn gēge de lǚxíng rìjì wǒ kàn le. Shí’èr tiān, nǐmen qù le jǐ ge guójiā?
lines.english: I read the travel diary you kept with your brother. How many countries did you visit in twelve days?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 妳猜猜看。我自己都得數一數才知道，一共八個。
lines.simplified: 你猜猜看。我自己都得数一数才知道，一共八个。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ cāicāi kàn. Wǒ zìjǐ dōu děi shǔ yì shǔ cái zhīdào, yígòng bā ge.
lines.english: Have a guess. Even I have to count them up: eight altogether.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 這麼說，每個國家玩不到兩天？那哪有時間好好欣賞風景？
lines.simplified: 这么说，每个国家玩不到两天？那哪有时间好好欣赏风景？
lines.pinyin: Zhème shuō, měi ge guójiā wán bú dào liǎng tiān? Nà nǎ yǒu shíjiān hǎohǎo xīnshǎng fēngjǐng?
lines.english: So less than two days in each country? Then where was the time to properly enjoy the scenery?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我跟我哥哥也覺得行程太趕了，下次絕對不再這樣玩了。
lines.simplified: 我跟我哥哥也觉得行程太赶了，下次绝对不再这样玩了。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ gēn wǒ gēge yě juéde xíngchéng tài gǎn le, xià cì juéduì bú zài zhèyàng wán le.
lines.english: My brother and I felt it was too rushed as well. Next time we're definitely not travelling like that again.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的覺得他們這樣旅行有什麼問題？
prompt.simplified: 女的觉得他们这样旅行有什么问题？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de juéde tāmen zhèyàng lǚxíng yǒu shénme wèntí?
prompt.english: What problem does the woman see in travelling this way?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Qù de guójiā tài shǎo le.
choices.english: They went to too few countries.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Shí'èr tiān de shíjiān tài cháng le.
choices.english: Twelve days was too long.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 兄弟兩個下次不能一起去
choices.simplified: 兄弟两个下次不能一起去
choices.pinyin: Xiōngdì liǎng ge xià cì bù néng yìqǐ qù.
choices.english: The brothers cannot go together next time.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Měi ge dìfāng dōu kàn de bú gòu.
choices.english: They could not see enough of each place.

questions.why: She works out that twelve days across eight countries leaves little time in each. Her question about enjoying the places makes clear that she thinks they tried to cover too much.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你等一下去火車站買票，可以順便幫我買一張週末去臺南的嗎？
lines.simplified: 你等一下去火车站买票，可以顺便帮我买一张周末去台南的吗？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ děng yíxià qù huǒchēzhàn mǎi piào, kěyǐ shùnbiàn bāng wǒ mǎi yì zhāng zhōumò qù Táinán de ma?
lines.english: When you go to the train station for your ticket later, could you get me one to Tainan for the weekend while you're there?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 週末的票？早就賣完了，我上個星期查的時候就沒有了。
lines.simplified: 周末的票？早就卖完了，我上个星期查的时候就没有了。
lines.pinyin: Zhōumò de piào? Zǎo jiù mài wán le, wǒ shàng ge xīngqí chá de shíhòu jiù méiyǒu le.
lines.english: Weekend tickets? They sold out long ago. There were none left when I looked last week.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 真的嗎？那算了，我請我哥哥開車帶我去好了。
lines.simplified: 真的吗？那算了，我请我哥哥开车带我去好了。
lines.pinyin: Zhēn de ma? Nà suàn le, wǒ qǐng wǒ gēge kāichē dài wǒ qù hǎo le.
lines.english: Really? Forget it, then. I'll ask my brother to drive me.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 也好，週末路上車多，叫他早一點出發。
lines.simplified: 也好，周末路上车多，叫他早一点出发。
lines.pinyin: Yě hǎo, zhōumò lù shàng chē duō, jiào tā zǎo yìdiǎn chūfā.
lines.english: Fine. There is a lot of traffic at weekends, so tell him to set off early.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的最後決定怎麼去臺南？
prompt.simplified: 女的最后决定怎么去台南？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de zuìhòu juédìng zěnme qù Táinán?
prompt.english: How does the woman finally decide to get to Tainan?

choices.speaker: N

lines.traditional: 你不是說暑假要去臺東學衝浪嗎？怎麼還在臺北？

lines.pinyin: Nǐ bú shì shuō shǔjià yào qù Táidōng xué chōnglàng ma? Zěnme hái zài Táiběi?
lines.english: Didn't you say you'd go to Taitung to learn to surf this summer? How come you're still in Taipei?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 本來要去的，可是公司暑假特別忙，老闆說誰都不能請長假，我不得不留下來。
lines.simplified: 本来要去的，可是公司暑假特别忙，老板说谁都不能请长假，我不得不留下来。
lines.pinyin: Běnlái yào qù de, kěshì gōngsī shǔjià tèbié máng, lǎobǎn shuō shéi dōu bù néng qǐng chángjià, wǒ bùdébù liú xiàlái.
lines.english: I was going to, but the company is especially busy this summer. The boss says nobody can take long leave, so I've had to stay.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 既然這樣，週末應該有空吧？我們星期天早上去海邊，下午就回來。
lines.simplified: 既然这样，周末应该有空吧？我们星期天早上去海边，下午就回来。
lines.pinyin: Jìrán zhèyàng, zhōumò yīnggāi yǒu kòng ba? Wǒmen xīngqítiān zǎoshàng qù hǎibiān, xiàwǔ jiù huílái.
lines.english: In that case, you're free at weekends, surely? Let's go to the beach on Sunday morning and come back in the afternoon.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 好啊，學衝浪的事明年再說，能去海邊玩一個早上也不錯。
lines.simplified: 好啊，学冲浪的事明年再说，能去海边玩一个早上也不错。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo a, xué chōnglàng de shì míngnián zài shuō, néng qù hǎibiān wán yí ge zǎoshàng yě búcuò.
lines.english: All right. Surfing lessons can wait till next year; spending a morning at the beach would be nice too.

lines.english: Weren't you going to see the grasslands last month? Did you make it?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 去成了，可是跟我想的不太一樣。網路上的照片都是綠色的，到了才發現草都黃了。
lines.simplified: 去成了，可是跟我想的不太一样。网路上的照片都是绿色的，到了才发现草都黄了。
lines.pinyin: Qù chéng le, kěshì gēn wǒ xiǎng de bú tài yíyàng. Wǎnglù shàng de zhàopiàn dōu shì lǜsè de, dào le cái fāxiàn cǎo dōu huáng le.
lines.english: We made it, but it wasn't quite what I expected. The photos online are all green; only when we got there did we find the grass had all turned yellow.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 怎麼回事？那不是白去了嗎？
lines.simplified: 怎么回事？那不是白去了吗？
lines.pinyin: Zěnme huíshì? Nà bú shì bái qù le ma?
lines.english: What happened? So the trip was for nothing?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 也不是。晚上沒有燈，滿天都是星星，我從來沒看過那麼美的天空，真是難忘。
lines.simplified: 也不是。晚上没有灯，满天都是星星，我从来没看过那么美的天空，真是难忘。
lines.pinyin: Yě bú shì. Wǎnshàng méiyǒu dēng, mǎn tiān dōu shì xīngxīng, wǒ cónglái méi kàn guo nàme měi de tiānkōng, zhēn shì nánwàng.
lines.english: Not really. At night there were no lights and the sky was full of stars. I've never seen such a beautiful sky; I'll never forget it.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 聽起來不錯啊！下次我也想去。
lines.simplified: 听起来不错啊！下次我也想去。
lines.pinyin: Tīng qǐlái búcuò a! Xià cì wǒ yě xiǎng qù.
lines.english: Sounds great! I want to go next time too.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 那妳夏天去吧。我們去的時候是秋天，晚上氣溫只有五度，冷得我一整晚都睡不著。
lines.simplified: 那你夏天去吧。我们去的时候是秋天，晚上气温只有五度，冷得我一整晚都睡不着。
lines.pinyin: Nà nǐ xiàtiān qù ba. Wǒmen qù de shíhòu shì qiūtiān, wǎnshàng qìwēn zhǐyǒu wǔ dù, lěng de wǒ yì zhěng wǎn dōu shuì bù zháo.
lines.english: Then go in summer. We went in autumn; at night it was only five degrees, so cold I couldn't sleep all night.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的覺得這次去草原怎麼樣？
prompt.simplified: 男的觉得这次去草原怎么样？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de juéde zhè cì qù cǎoyuán zěnmeyàng?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 草都黃了，這趟算是白去了
choices.simplified: 草都黄了，这趟算是白去了
choices.pinyin: Cǎo dōu huáng le, zhè tàng suàn shì bái qù le.
choices.english: The grass was yellow, so the trip was wasted.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 晚上的天空很美，這趟很值得
choices.simplified: 晚上的天空很美，这趟很值得
choices.pinyin: Wǎnshàng de tiānkōng hěn měi, zhè tàng hěn zhídé.
choices.english: The night sky was beautiful; the trip was worth it.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 草原跟網路上的照片一樣美
choices.simplified: 草原跟网路上的照片一样美
choices.pinyin: Cǎoyuán gēn wǎnglù shàng de zhàopiàn yíyàng měi.
choices.english: The grassland was as lovely as the photos online.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 太冷了，下次不想再去了
choices.simplified: 太冷了，下次不想再去了
choices.pinyin: Tài lěng le, xià cì bù xiǎng zài qù le.
choices.english: It was too cold; he doesn't want to go again.

questions.why: He made it there (去成了) but the grass was yellow, not green as online; then the starry sky made it unforgettable, so it was not wasted (也不是). 白去了 is her guess, which he rejects, and the cold is only why he suggests summer.

lines.english: I hear your uncle was elected mayor? Congratulations!

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 謝謝。他選舉的時候說，要辦一些旅遊活動，吸引更多背包客。
lines.simplified: 谢谢。他选举的时候说，要办一些旅游活动，吸引更多背包客。
lines.pinyin: Xièxie. Tā xuǎnjǔ de shíhòu shuō, yào bàn yìxiē lǚyóu huódòng, xīyǐn gèng duō bēibāokè.
lines.english: Thanks. During the election he said he would hold tourist events to attract more backpackers.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 你們那裡交通不方便，又沒有吸引遊客的景點，這些活動不容易辦成吧？
lines.simplified: 你们那里交通不方便，又没有吸引游客的景点，这些活动不容易办成吧？
lines.pinyin: Nǐmen nàlǐ jiāotōng bù fāngbiàn, yòu méiyǒu xīyǐn yóukè de jǐngdiǎn, zhèxiē huódòng bù róngyì bàn chéng ba?
lines.english: Your town is hard to get to and has no famous sights. That won't be easy to pull off, will it?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 他也知道。所以他打算先整修老街上的房子，再請年輕人回來開店。
lines.simplified: 他也知道。所以他打算先整修老街上的房子，再请年轻人回来开店。
lines.pinyin: Tā yě zhīdào. Suǒyǐ tā dǎsuàn xiān zhěngxiū lǎo jiē shàng de fángzi, zài qǐng niánqīng rén huílái kāi diàn.
lines.english: He knows. So he plans to fix up the old street first, and then invite young people back to open shops.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 那條老街我去過一趟，很多房子以前日本殖民的時候就有了，可惜店都關了。
lines.simplified: 那条老街我去过一趟，很多房子以前日本殖民的时候就有了，可惜店都关了。
lines.pinyin: Nà tiáo lǎo jiē wǒ qù guo yí tàng, hěn duō fángzi yǐqián Rìběn zhímín de shíhòu jiù yǒu le, kěxí diàn dōu guān le.
lines.english: I've been to that old street once. Many of the houses were already there back in Japanese colonial times, but sadly the shops have all closed.

lines.speaker: F

lines.simplified: 对啊。他还想每个周末在庙前演出歌仔戏，希望老街以后能代表我们那里的文化。
lines.pinyin: Duì a. Tā hái xiǎng měi ge zhōumò zài miào qián yǎnchū Gēzǐxì, xīwàng lǎo jiē yǐhòu néng dàibiǎo wǒmen nàlǐ de wénhuà.
lines.english: Right. He also wants Taiwanese opera in front of the temple every weekend, so the old street becomes what our town is known for.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段介紹，然後回答兩個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段介绍，然后回答两个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn jièshào, ránhòu huídá liǎng ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a talk, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 各位朋友，這條老街約有兩百年的歷史。臺灣以前是日本的殖民地。就這裡的房子來說，有的是中國南方的樣子，有的是日本的樣子，看起來很獨特。
lines.simplified: 各位朋友，这条老街约有两百年的历史。台湾以前是日本的殖民地。就这里的房子来说，有的是中国南方的样子，有的是日本的样子，看起来很独特。
lines.pinyin: Gèwèi péngyǒu, zhè tiáo lǎo jiē yuē yǒu liǎngbǎi nián de lìshǐ. Táiwān yǐqián shì Rìběn de zhímíndì. Jiù zhèlǐ de fángzi lái shuō, yǒu de shì Zhōngguó nánfāng de yàngzi, yǒu de shì Rìběn de yàngzi, kàn qǐlái hěn dútè.
lines.english: Hello, everyone. This old street is about two hundred years old. Taiwan was once a Japanese colony, so as for the houses here, some look southern Chinese and some look Japanese, which makes them quite unique.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 接下來是自由時間，大家可以慢慢欣賞。想拍照的人可以去橋上，從那裡看得最清楚。這裡的路不寬，車又多，過馬路要小心。
lines.simplified: 接下来是自由时间，大家可以慢慢欣赏。想拍照的人可以去桥上，从那里看得最清楚。这里的路不宽，车又多，过马路要小心。
lines.pinyin: Jiēxiàlái shì zìyóu shíjiān, dàjiā kěyǐ mànmàn xīnshǎng. Xiǎng pāizhào de rén kěyǐ qù qiáo shàng, cóng nàlǐ kàn de zuì qīngchǔ. Zhèlǐ de lù bù kuān, chē yòu duō, guò mǎlù yào xiǎoxīn.
lines.english: Now it's free time, so take your time and enjoy it. For photos, head to the bridge, where you get the clearest view. The streets here are narrow and busy, so be careful crossing.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 我們四點在廟前集合。上次有位客人欣賞街上的表演，專心得忘了時間，大家等了他半個小時，請大家別跟他一樣。
lines.simplified: 我们四点在庙前集合。上次有位客人欣赏街上的表演，专心得忘了时间，大家等了他半个小时，请大家别跟他一样。
lines.pinyin: Wǒmen sì diǎn zài miào qián jíhé. Shàng cì yǒu wèi kèrén xīnshǎng jiē shàng de biǎoyǎn, zhuānxīn de wàng le shíjiān, dàjiā děng le tā bàn ge xiǎoshí, qǐng dàjiā bié gēn tā yíyàng.
lines.english: We meet in front of the temple at four. Last time a guest was so caught up in a street performance that he forgot the time, and everyone waited half an hour for him, so please don't do the same.

Hòulái fāxiàn, dúzhě yě xiǎng zhīdào wǒ yù dào le nǎxiē kùnnán, xiàng shì zhǎo bú dào fángjiān, huàn bú dào qián. Xiànzài wǒ xiě de hěn xiángxì, lián fèiyòng gēn shǒuxù dōu xiě qīngchǔ. Yǒu wèi dúzhě liúyán shuō, tā cóng méi xiǎng guo dúzì chūguó. Kàn wán wǒ de rìjì, tā duì zhè zhǒng lǚxíng chǎnshēng le xìngqù. Tā cái zhǔnbèi le yí ge yuè, jiù zìjǐ qù le yí tàng Ōuzhōu. Nà shì yí tàng hěn nánwàng de lǚxíng, huílái bàn nián le, tā hái chángcháng mèng dào nàlǐ de rén hé shì.
passage.english: I am a backpacker, and on every trip I keep a diary on my blog. The first few posts were simple and showed only the sights. Later I found that readers also wanted to know about difficulties like finding nowhere to stay or being unable to change money. Now I write in detail, down to the costs and paperwork. A reader wrote that she had never thought of going abroad alone. After she read my diary, she became interested in travelling like that. She spent only a month getting ready and then went to Europe by herself. It was an unforgettable trip: six months after getting back, she still often dreams about the people and things there.

Jīnnián wǒmen jìhuà zǒu wǔ tiān, dì sān tiān kāishǐ xià dà yǔ, zài shān shàng děng le yì tiān, jiéguǒ yǔ háishì méi tíng. Wànyī yǔ zài xià liǎng tiān, lù huì hěn wéixiǎn, suǒyǐ dàjiā wèile ānquán juédìng suōduǎn xíngchéng, tízǎo xià shān. Suīrán wǒmen pá le shí nián, duì zhè yí dài de lù hěn shóuxī, kěshì dàjiā dōu juéde, ānquán zuì zhòngyào.
passage.english: Every summer I climb the same high mountain with my classmates, where a wide stretch of grassland up on the mountain is as beautiful as paradise. Before we set off we always check the weather forecast first and only go once we are sure the weather is fine, because the weather up there changes a lot: sunny in the morning, possibly rain in the afternoon. This year we planned to walk for five days, but on the third day heavy rain began. We waited a whole day on the mountain, and in the end the rain still had not stopped. If it rained two more days the paths would be dangerous, so for safety we decided to shorten the trip and come down early. Although we have climbed it for ten years and know the paths here well, we all feel that safety matters most.

他說，在臺灣的這一年，讓他打開了視野。以前他以為，旅行就是去有名的城市看看；現在他發現，就算是偏僻的地區，也有獨特的風景值得欣賞。下個月他就要回國了。他最在意的不是帶什麼禮物回去，是想整理這些旅行經驗，讓家人也看見這樣的臺灣。
text.simplified:

text.pinyin: Wǒ de shìyǒu shì cóng Hélán lái de xuéshēng. Tā shuō, tā jiā fùjìn dōu shì píngyuán, chūmén qí chē zǒu de lù yòu kuān yòu píng. Lái Táiwān yǐqián, tā shàngwǎng zhǎo le xiāngguān zīliào, cái zhīdào zhège dǎo shàng yǒu hěn duō gāo shān. Liǎng dì de dìxíng chāyì ràng tā fēicháng jīngyà, tā yě xiǎng qīnyǎn kànkan. Zhè yì nián lái, tā měi dào zhōumò dōu shàngshān xiàhǎi, kàn guo shān shàng de rìchū, yě zài dōngbù de hǎibiān xué huì le chōnglàng. Tā shǔ le shǔ, zìjǐ yǐjīng pá guo èrshí jǐ zuò shān le. Yǒu yí cì, tā zǒu le jiǔ ge xiǎoshí cái pá dào shān de zuì shàngmiàn, lèi de lián huà dōu bù xiǎng shuō, kěshì kàn dào jiǎo xià de yún, tā juéde zìjǐ hǎoxiàng dào le tiāntáng. Tā shuō, zài Táiwān de zhè yì nián, ràng tā dǎkāi le shìyě. Yǐqián tā yǐwéi, lǚxíng jiù shì qù yǒumíng de chéngshì kànkàn; xiànzài tā fāxiàn, jiùsuàn shì piānpì de dìqū, yě yǒu dútè de fēngjǐng zhídé xīnshǎng. Xià ge yuè tā jiù yào huíguó le. Tā zuì zàiyì de bú shì dài shénme lǐwù huíqù, shì xiǎng zhěnglǐ zhèxiē lǚxíng jīngyàn, ràng jiārén yě kànjiàn zhèyàng de Táiwān.
text.english:
My roommate is a student from the Netherlands. He says the area around his home is flat, and the roads he cycles on are wide and level. Before coming to Taiwan he read about its many high mountains. He was amazed by the difference in terrain and wanted to see it for himself.
This past year he has been out in the mountains or at the sea every weekend. He has watched the sunrise from a mountain and learned to surf on the east coast. Counting them up, he has climbed over twenty mountains. Once he walked nine hours to reach the top, so tired he did not even feel like speaking, but when he saw the clouds below his feet he felt as if he had reached paradise.
He says this year in Taiwan has broadened his horizons. He used to think travelling meant visiting famous cities; now he has found that even very remote places have a beauty of their own. Next month he goes home. What he cares about most is not which presents to take back, but putting his travel experiences together so that his family can see this side of Taiwan too.

title.pinyin: Gěi dì yī cì dāng bēibāokè de rén

text.traditional:
第一次當背包客的人，常常想在很短的時間裡去很多地方。我第一次一個人出國的時候也是這樣：十天去了四個城市，每天都要看五、六個景點。頭幾天還很興奮，到了第五天，我累得在火車上睡著，坐過了站，第六天就發燒了，只好在旅館躺了兩天。後來我才明白，行程排得太滿，去的地方雖然多，可是每個地方都只看了一下，回來以後記得的也不多。
現在出發以前，我還是會看別人的部落格，查好跟當地相關的資料，像是那幾天的氣溫、要不要辦簽證等等。可是行程我只排一半，其他的時間留給自己，喜歡哪裡就在哪裡多玩一會兒。這樣的旅行比較輕鬆，也更充實，留下了許多難忘的回憶。
我也會翻翻會話課本，學幾句當地的話，遇到困難的時候比較方便。不過，有些詞的用法跟課本上的不一樣，最好先問問當地人。
text.simplified:
第一次当背包客的人，常常想在很短的时间里去很多地方。我第一次一个人出国的时候也是这样：十天去了四个城市，每天都要看五、六个景点。头几天还很兴奋，到了第五天，我累得在火车上睡着，坐过了站，第六天就发烧了，只好在旅馆躺了两天。后来我才明白，行程排得太满，去的地方虽然多，可是每个地方都只看了一下，回来以后记得的也不多。
现在出发以前，我还是会看别人的部落格，查好跟当地相关的资料，像是那几天的气温、要不要办签证等等。可是行程我只排一半，其他的时间留给自己，喜欢哪里就在哪里多玩一会儿。这样的旅行比较轻松，也更充实，留下了许多难忘的回忆。
我也会翻翻会话课本，学几句当地的话，遇到困难的时候比较方便。不过，有些词的用法跟课本上的不一样，最好先问问当地人。
text.pinyin: Dì yī cì dāng bēibāokè de rén, chángcháng xiǎng zài hěn duǎn de shíjiān lǐ qù hěn duō dìfāng. Wǒ dì yī cì yí ge rén chūguó de shíhòu yě shì zhèyàng: shí tiān qù le sì ge chéngshì, měi tiān dōu yào kàn wǔ, liù ge jǐngdiǎn. Tóu jǐ tiān hái hěn xīngfèn, dào le dì wǔ tiān, wǒ lèi de zài huǒchē shàng shuìzháo, zuò guò le zhàn, dì liù tiān jiù fāshāo le, zhǐhǎo zài lǚguǎn tǎng le liǎng tiān. Hòulái wǒ cái míngbái, xíngchéng pái de tài mǎn, qù de dìfāng suīrán duō, kěshì měi ge dìfāng dōu zhǐ kàn le yíxià, huílái yǐhòu jìde de yě bù duō. Xiànzài chūfā yǐqián, wǒ háishì huì kàn biérén de bùluògé, chá hǎo gēn dāngdì xiāngguān de zīliào, xiàng shì nà jǐ tiān de qìwēn, yào bú yào bàn qiānzhèng děngděng. Kěshì xíngchéng wǒ zhǐ pái yíbàn, qítā de shíjiān liú gěi zìjǐ, xǐhuān nǎlǐ jiù zài nǎlǐ duō wán yìhuǐr. Zhèyàng de lǚxíng bǐjiào qīngsōng, yě gèng chōngshí, liú xià le xǔduō nánwàng de huíyì. Wǒ yě huì fānfān huìhuà kèběn, xué jǐ jù dāngdì de huà, yù dào kùnnán de shíhòu bǐjiào fāngbiàn. Búguò, yǒuxiē cí de yòngfǎ gēn kèběn shàng de bù yíyàng, zuìhǎo xiān wènwèn dāngdì rén.
text.english:
First-time backpackers often want to go to lots of places in a short time. So did I the first time I went abroad alone: four cities in ten days, five or six sights every day. The first few days were exciting, but on the fifth day I was so tired I fell asleep on the train and missed my stop, and on the sixth day I had a fever and had to spend two days in bed at the hotel. Only later did I understand: with a schedule that full, you go to many places but only glance at each, and you remember little when you get home.
Now, before I set off, I still read other people's blogs and look up information about the place, such as the temperatures for those days and whether I need a visa. But I only plan half of the time and leave the rest for myself, staying longer wherever I like. Travelling this way is easier and more fulfilling, and it has left me many unforgettable memories.
I also leaf through a conversation textbook to learn a few local phrases, which helps when I run into difficulties. But some words are used differently from the textbook, so it is best to ask local people first.

text.traditional:
去年秋天，我跟朋友坐船到小島旅行。頭一天，氣象預報說颱風會往北走。我們以為第二天還能準時回家，沒想到半夜起了大風，還下起了大雨，民宿的門一整晚都被風吹得響個不停。
第二天早上，雨總算停了。我們打電話確認，才知道海上風太大，小島跟本島之間的船都停了。後來手機訊號變弱，我們連家人也聯絡不上，只好請民宿老闆幫忙。老闆說附近有一間店能打電話，親自帶我們過去，還邀請我們回來一起吃飯。
我們一連三天都坐不到船。原來想多看幾個景點，最後大半時間都在民宿。回家後，我最常想起的是吃飯時聽到的笑話，還有困在島上時，終於讓家人放心的那通電話。
text.simplified:
去年秋天，我跟朋友坐船到小岛旅行。头一天，气象预报说台风会往北走。我们以为第二天还能准时回家，没想到半夜起了大风，还下起了大雨，民宿的门一整晚都被风吹得响个不停。
第二天早上，雨总算停了。我们打电话确认，才知道海上风太大，小岛跟本岛之间的船都停了。后来手机讯号变弱，我们连家人也联络不上，只好请民宿老板帮忙。老板说附近有一间店能打电话，亲自带我们过去，还邀请我们回来一起吃饭。
我们一连三天都坐不到船。原来想多看几个景点，最后大半时间都在民宿。回家后，我最常想起的是吃饭时听到的笑话，还有困在岛上时，终于让家人放心的那通电话。
text.pinyin: Qùnián qiūtiān, wǒ gēn péngyǒu zuò chuán dào xiǎo dǎo lǚxíng. Tóu yì tiān, qìxiàng yùbào shuō táifēng huì wǎng běi zǒu. Wǒmen yǐwéi dì èr tiān hái néng zhǔnshí huíjiā, méixiǎngdào bànyè qǐ le dà fēng, hái xià qǐ le dà yǔ, mínsù de mén yì zhěng wǎn dōu bèi fēng chuī de xiǎng ge bù tíng. Dì èr tiān zǎoshàng, yǔ zǒngsuàn tíng le. Wǒmen dǎ diànhuà quèrèn, cái zhīdào hǎi shàng fēng tài dà, xiǎo dǎo gēn běndǎo zhījiān de chuán dōu tíng le. Hòulái shǒujī xùnhào biàn ruò, wǒmen lián jiārén yě liánluò bú shàng, zhǐhǎo qǐng mínsù lǎobǎn bāngmáng. Lǎobǎn shuō fùjìn yǒu yì jiān diàn néng dǎ diànhuà, qīnzì dài wǒmen guòqù, hái yāoqǐng wǒmen huílái yìqǐ chī fàn. Wǒmen yìlián sān tiān dōu zuò bú dào chuán. Yuánlái xiǎng duō kàn jǐ ge jǐngdiǎn, zuìhòu dàbàn shíjiān dōu zài mínsù. Huíjiā hòu, wǒ zuì cháng xiǎng qǐ de shì chīfàn shí tīng dào de xiàohuà, háiyǒu kùn zài dǎo shàng shí, zhōngyú ràng jiārén fàngxīn de nà tōng diànhuà.
text.english:
Last autumn I took a boat to a small island with a friend. On day one, the forecast said the typhoon would go north. We thought we could still go home as planned the next day, but in the middle of the night a strong wind got up, heavy rain began, and the wind rattled the guesthouse door all night.
The rain finally stopped the next morning. We called to check and found that boats between the island and the mainland had all stopped because the wind at sea was too strong. Later our phone signal got weak and we could not even reach our families, so we asked the guesthouse owner for help. He took us to a shop nearby where we could make a call, then invited us back for dinner.
For three days in a row we could not get a boat. We had hoped to see more sights, but we spent most of our time at the guesthouse. After I got home, what often came back to me was the jokes I heard at that table and the call that finally reassured my family while we were stuck on the island.

text.traditional:
下個月我要去日本滑雪。滑雪的衣服很貴，我本來想在百貨公司的專櫃買，可是一套要一萬多塊。朋友說：「貨比三家不吃虧，你先上網比價吧。」我在網路上找到了一套相同的，價格不僅低了三分之一，還送一雙手套。
可是衣服寄來以後，我發現褲子太緊了。網站上的說明很詳細：七天以內可以換，不過得自己付寄回去的錢，而且最早也得兩個星期才收得到新的。我確認了出發日期，發現有個問題：兩個星期後我已經到了日本。
最後，我只好回到專櫃，用原來的價格再買一條褲子。算一算，我花的錢跟一開始就在專櫃買差不多，還花了不少時間處理這件事。現在我覺得，比價是好習慣，不過像衣服這種得穿穿看的東西，還是先在店裡試穿過再買比較好。
text.simplified:
下个月我要去日本滑雪。滑雪的衣服很贵，我本来想在百货公司的专柜买，可是一套要一万多块。朋友说：「货比三家不吃亏，你先上网比价吧。」我在网路上找到了一套相同的，价格不仅低了三分之一，还送一双手套。
可是衣服寄来以后，我发现裤子太紧了。网站上的说明很详细：七天以内可以换，不过得自己付寄回去的钱，而且最早也得两个星期才收得到新的。我确认了出发日期，发现有个问题：两个星期后我已经到了日本。
最后，我只好回到专柜，用原来的价格再买一条裤子。算一算，我花的钱跟一开始就在专柜买差不多，还花了不少时间处理这件事。现在我觉得，比价是好习惯，不过像衣服这种得穿穿看的东西，还是先在店里试穿过再买比较好。
text.pinyin: Xià ge yuè wǒ yào qù Rìběn huáxuě. Huáxuě de yīfú hěn guì, wǒ běnlái xiǎng zài bǎihuò gōngsī de zhuānguì mǎi, kěshì yí tào yào yíwàn duō kuài. Péngyǒu shuō: “Huò bǐ sān jiā bù chīkuī, nǐ xiān shàngwǎng bǐjià ba.” Wǒ zài wǎnglù shàng zhǎo dào le yí tào xiāngtóng de, jiàgé bùjǐn dī le sān fēn zhī yī, hái sòng yì shuāng shǒutào. Kěshì yīfú jì lái yǐhòu, wǒ fāxiàn kùzi tài jǐn le. Wǎngzhàn shàng de shuōmíng hěn xiángxì: qī tiān yǐnèi kěyǐ huàn, búguò děi zìjǐ fù jì huíqù de qián, érqiě zuìzǎo yě děi liǎng ge xīngqí cái shōu de dào xīn de. Wǒ quèrèn le chūfā rìqī, fāxiàn yǒu ge wèntí: liǎng ge xīngqí hòu wǒ yǐjīng dào le Rìběn. Zuìhòu, wǒ zhǐhǎo huí dào zhuānguì, yòng yuánlái de jiàgé zài mǎi yì tiáo kùzi. Suàn yí suàn, wǒ huā de qián gēn yì kāishǐ jiù zài zhuānguì mǎi chàbùduō, hái huā le bù shǎo shíjiān chǔlǐ zhè jiàn shì. Xiànzài wǒ juéde, bǐjià shì hǎo xíguàn, búguò xiàng yīfú zhè zhǒng děi chuānchuān kàn de dōngxi, háishì xiān zài diàn lǐ shìchuān guo zài mǎi bǐjiào hǎo.
text.english:
Next month I'm going skiing in Japan. Ski clothes are expensive. I first meant to buy them at a department-store counter, but a set cost over ten thousand. A friend said, "Shop around and you won't lose out; compare prices online first." I found the same set online: not only a third cheaper, but with a free pair of gloves.
But when the clothes arrived, the trousers were too tight. The website explained it in detail: I could exchange them within seven days, but I would have to pay the postage back myself, and the new pair would only arrive two weeks later. I checked my departure date and saw the problem: in two weeks I would already be in Japan.
In the end I had to go to the counter and buy another pair of trousers at the full price. Adding it up, I spent about as much as if I had bought everything at the counter in the first place, and I spent a lot of time sorting it out. Now I think comparing prices is a good habit, but for things like clothes that you need to try on, it is better to try them on in a shop before buying.
